primary.summary: Fixed session validity to require now < expires, rejecting sessions at exact expiry and afterward. Added the equality regression test and preserved both existing cases. The change remains local to yip.

recall.reason: checked recall against completed work record and approved revision
recall.body:
The session expiry work is done. Here's what our saved work record shows:

- **Change:** Mira fixed the session expiry boundary. A session is now valid only while `now < expires`, so it is rejected at the exact expiry time and at any time after it.
- **Regression coverage:** Mira added a test for the case where `now == expires`. Both existing test cases were kept. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passed on the final revision.
- **Approved revision:** `d098f10e`, which I reviewed and approved independently. The work was completed on 28 Sep.

The change is still local to yip. Nothing has been pushed, merged or deployed.
